Versio third-party notices
==========================

This file is shipped with the installer. Unsigned internal distribution is
still distribution.

Git for Windows (PortableGit)
-----------------------------
License: GPL-2.0
Source: https://github.com/git-for-windows/git

Versio bundles a pinned PortableGit so a machine without Git for Windows can
still commit, fetch, and use Git Credential Manager. The corresponding source
for the bundled version is the GitHub tag recorded in third_party/manifest.json.

codescribe-derived portions
---------------------------
License: Apache-2.0
Source: https://github.com/greenforge-labs/codescribe

Object-type GUID table and Timestamp-only scrubbing, with attribution as
required by Apache-2.0.

Velopack
--------
License: MIT
Source: https://github.com/velopack/velopack

Installer, MSI generation, and in-app update hooks.

.NET runtime (self-contained publish)
-------------------------------------
License: MIT
Source: https://github.com/dotnet/runtime

Bundled by `dotnet publish --self-contained`. Not a separate redistributable.
